item.title: Michael Moore calls Democratic Party 'cowards' who actually support Iran war
item.summary: Michael Moore claimed Democratic Party leadership supports the Iran conflict after arguing President Donald Trump made a "holocaust" level threat against the country.

item.title: UK's NATO show of force ends with docked destroyer in Mediterranean after 'technical' issue
item.summary: The U.K. docked its sole naval warship in the Mediterranean due to technical issues amid growing criticism of PM Starmer's response to the Iran war.

item.title: Top GOP hawk Graham warns Iran deal has ‘troubling aspects’ as ceasefire begins
item.summary: Sen. Lindsey Graham, R-S.C., says the Iran ceasefire deal has "troubling aspects" and calls for a diplomatic solution that stops Iran's nuclear enrichment program completely.

item.title: Trump critics go from outrage over Iran threat to mocking him as 'chicken' for not following through
item.summary: Critics slammed President Donald Trump's Iran threat as potential genocide, then mocked him for not following through, using the viral TACO acronym.

item.summary: Snag these genuine Swarovski earrings, necklaces, bracelets and jewelry sets while they're up to 55% off on Amazon.

item.title: Kirk Cousins reveals how a FaceTime call with Tom Brady sealed his decision to join the Raiders
item.summary: Kirk Cousins credited Tom Brady for giving him a big nudge toward signing with the Las Vegas Raiders, calling their FaceTime conversation "life-giving."

item.title: Deadly bacterial disease could be stopped with common pantry staple, study suggests
item.summary: A high-protein diet rich in casein and wheat gluten could "disarm" cholera bacteria, cutting infection levels by 100-fold, a new UC Riverside study finds.

item.title: Davey Lopes, four-time All-Star and one of MLB's greatest base stealers, dead at 80
item.summary: Davey Lopes, a four-time MLB All-Star and 1981 World Series champion with the Dodgers, has died at 80. He ranks 26th all-time in stolen bases.

item.title: Vogue’s Anna Wintour takes swipe at Melania Trump’s style while praising liberal favorites
item.summary: Former Vogue editor-in-chief Anna Wintour remarked how first lady Melania Trump always "looks like herself" in a new interview for her magazine on Tuesday.

item.title: Trump admin scores Minnesota court win in Medicaid fraud crackdown
item.summary: Minnesota's bid to block the Trump administration from withholding over $259 million in Medicaid funds failed after a federal judge called the state's legal challenge premature.
